snippet.title: Warren & Julie Travel - Slow Travel Nomad Expats
snippet.description:
We are Warren & Julie, early retirement travelers who have embraced the full-time nomadic expat lifestyle since March 2020. We immerse ourselves in each country for 1 to 3 months, punctuating our stay with side trips and thrilling adventures. We love diving deep into the culture, meeting the locals, and exploring the cost of living while also indulging in popular tourist attractions.

Our travels come with detailed cost breakdowns to help you understand the true expenses of an expat's full-time journey. And yes, our two dogs, Katie and Arya, tag along, adding an extra layer of adventure! 

We also produce residency videos, conduct expat interviews, and create financial planning content to help you navigate the complexities of living abroad.

Join us on our slow travel, early retirement journey! Ready to roam the world with us? Subscribe and get a firsthand look at how we live and travel. From local life to tourist spots, experience it all with our travel guide! 🌍✨

snippet.title: Our Rich Journey
snippet.description:
Welcome to Our Rich Journey!

If you’ve been following our story, you know that our family of four reached FIRE (financial independence retire early) in August 2019. That’s right - at the age of 39, we retired early and moved to Lisbon, Portugal!

When we started pursuing FIRE, the movement was relatively small and not many people knew about it.  But through our Channel, we’re hoping more people learn about FIRE! In our videos we share ways to make money, save money, and invest money - to inspire you to pursue financial independence.  

Our goal is to share our experiences with you, so that you can learn from them and so that you can also successfully pursue financial independence. We’ve created quite the community of Our Rich Journey FIRE starters.  So, what are you waiting for? Join the journey and start that FIRE! 

Subscribe NOW!

snippet.title: Brendan in Japan
snippet.description:
Have you ever thought about leaving everything behind and starting over in another country? 

Hi, I’m Brendan 👋 

Not long ago, I was living in Canada. I was climbing the corporate ladder, living a comfortable life, but the path felt too...prescribed. So I did something big - I sold my house, quit my job, and moved abroad 🚀

Oh, I brought my family and dog along for the ride too!

After a year living in the jungles of Thailand, we've settling in beautiful Japan 🇯🇵 

This channel is my personal look at life in Japan - the daily routines and the challenges of raising a family while building a new life from scratch.

💻 Let’s connect: brendan@kaishinconsulting.com

Welcome to The Financial Journey – your go-to podcast for mastering personal finance, investing, and U.S. market insights.
Our mission is simple: help you manage money smarter, invest with confidence, and understand the U.S. economy to build long-term wealth.

🎙️ What you’ll get on this channel:
Personal Finance (U.S.-focused): Budgeting, saving, debt management, credit scores.
Investing (U.S.-focused): Stocks, ETFs, retirement plans (401k, IRA), real estate.
Market Analysis & Economics: U.S. stock market trends, Fed policy, inflation, recession outlook.

Whether you’re just starting your financial journey or scaling your portfolio, this channel is designed to educate, simplify, and empower.
📌 Subscribe now and start building your financial freedom today.
#PersonalFinance #Investing #USMarket #FinancialPodcast #MoneyTips

snippet.title: Renay Cheyenne
snippet.description:
Welcome to my Rich Channel! This channel is about my post-graduate school journey through life as I explore shopping hauls, traveling, books, unboxing, and overall personal development to make up my lifestyle content. I wanted to show what it looks like after university. Specifically for me, I am displaying life post-graduate school however  many of the things that I go through can be cross applied to those post-high school, post-undergraduate, etc. I am taking you all through the ups, the downs, the good and the bad! I am happy you want to take this journey with me. See ya in the next video.

Until next time with Love and Richness,
~Renay Cheyenne! xoxo

snippet.title: Cashlytic
snippet.description:
Welcome to Cashlytic, your go-to destination for all things finance and investing! Whether you're a beginner looking to learn the basics or an experienced investor seeking to sharpen your strategies, Cashlytic is here to help you make smarter financial decisions.

On this channel, you'll find expert advice on building wealth, understanding the stock market, real estate, personal finance, and the latest investment trends. We break down complex financial concepts into easy-to-understand tips and insights, so you can confidently manage your money and grow your wealth.  Join us as we explore:

Stock market analysis
Investment strategies and tips
Personal finance management
Wealth-building techniques
Economic trends and updates

At Cashlytic, our mission is to provide you with the knowledge and tools you need to make informed financial decisions and achieve financial freedom. Don't forget to hit the subscribe button and stay tuned for weekly updates on all things finance and investing!

snippet.title: Gregory Galant
snippet.description:
Muck Rack & Shorty Awards co-founder/CEO Greg Galant interviews the world's best entrepreneurs and creators, including the founders of LinkedIn, The Vanguard Group, Yelp, Brooklyn Brewery, Trello, Twitter, and Stack Overflow.

Tune in for tips on how to build a business, how to succeed in business, how to think like an entrepreneur, how to fire retire early, how to become financially independent, how to scale and grow your business, how to excel in sales, how to hire the best talent for your business and more.  

Get exclusive insights from these interviews in my personal email newsletter:

https://venturevoice.substack.com/welcome

Follow and connect on social:
On Twitter: twitter.com/gregory
On Instagram: instagram.com/gregory
On LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/galant/

Learn more about Muck Rack at muckrack.com and The Shorty Awards at shortyawards.com

snippet.title: Strategic Early Retirement
snippet.description: We Retired Early to Travel Full-Time. The "dream" took more than money — it took new rules for our health, our identity, and how we actually live on the road. We share the honest truth: what works, what doesn't, and what no one warned us about.

snippet.title: Our Money Quest
snippet.description:
Welcome to Our Money Quest! 🚀

We are documenting our journey to Financial Independence and Early Retirement (FIRE). Join us as we navigate the path to freedom, transparency, and building a life we love—without waiting until age 65 to enjoy it.

We share the real, unfiltered truth about money. We don’t just talk about the wins; we open up about the challenges, the "boring" middle, and the major pivots we’ve made along the way.

What you can expect from our videos:

📉 Real Numbers: Transparent looks at our savings, expenses, and portfolio

🔥 FIRE Truths: The ups and downs of the Financial Independence Retire Early movement

💡 Smart Money Moves: Practical tips on frugality, investing, and lifestyle design

🛑 Mistakes & Lessons: honest discussions about what went wrong so you can avoid our errors

Whether you are just starting your financial journey or looking for a more balanced approach to wealth, you’ve found your community.

Subscribe to join us on the quest for financial freedom!

snippet.title: Graham Cochrane
snippet.description:
Build a high-income, low-maintenance business & life. I help entrepreneurs make more money, work fewer hours, and live a life of significance. 

Graham Cochrane is a USA Today bestselling author, entrepreneur, business coach, and keynote speaker who helps people create more money, margin, and meaning in their lives. He is the founder of The Effortless Business® and host of The Graham Cochrane Show, a top 0.5% ranked podcast globally.

Over the past 16 years, Graham has built multiple 7-figure online businesses that generate millions in revenue and require less than five hours a week to run. His frameworks have helped thousands of entrepreneurs simplify their business models, avoid burnout, and design high-income, low-maintenance businesses that align with their purpose.

His insights have been featured in Forbes, CNBC, Business Insider, and The Huffington Post, and his YouTube channels have attracted more than 65 million views and 700,000 subscribers.

snippet.title: Rachel Abiodun Wellness
snippet.description:
Breaking down hormone health in a way that’s simple to understand. I create content for women with fibroids, endometriosis, PCOS, and thyroid issues, sharing natural tools to help you reduce symptoms, balance your hormones, and feel more in control of your health.
From nutrition and stress support to root cause education and lifestyle tips, everything here is designed to empower you with knowledge AND next steps.
Subscribe and check out the Sisterhood 👉🏽 www.hormonesisterhood.com

snippet.title: First Gen Money
snippet.description:
Hi! I'm Dannielle, your first gen Latina amiga :) I make content about navigating life and relationships, managing money and building wealth.

When I'm not making YouTube videos or recording on the Amigas Get Money podcast, you can find me curled up on the couch with a book (probably non-fiction - though I am trying to read more fiction!) or watching the latest Netflix reality show.
